## Key schema interactions

Exercises the **external calibration** branch of calibration variants. Linear channels (Tx bias, Tx power, temperature, Vcc) use identity constants (slope=0x0100 in U8.8 format, offset=0x0000), so calibrated and raw values coincide. The Rx power polynomial is the constant 1.0 (degree 0), so a calibrated decoder reports 0.0001 mW while the aggregate golden (raw × fixed scale; aggregate decoders do not apply external calibration) reports 0.3 mW. The fixture therefore does distinguish the two paths, for Rx power only. This is the only fixture in the SFF-8472 corpus where A0h:92 bit 4 (externally_calibrated) is set and A2h:56-91 carry non-zero calibration constant bytes.
